diagnosis: D010 applies the route sentence instead of merely promising a patch, which is real progress from D009.

revision_demand: Do not make a receipt-only D011. Either build a reader-facing state object that makes the closed/open/patched transitions experiential, or freeze/graveyard the P0001 family and fork P0002 around external material/source pressure.
